Since `record_for_host` can return nil/false when there is no matching `EmbeddableHost` row (app/models/embeddable_host.rb), this creates a new edge case where embedded imports may be created with a nil category (likely defaulting to Uncategorized), and the previous global fallback (`SiteSetting.embed_category`) is removed from settings (config/site_settings.yml) and deleted in the migration. However, the finding’s specific feed-polling scenario (“item URLs live on a different host than the embedding page”) cannot be verified from this diff alone because the PollFeed/job call path and which URL is passed into TopicEmbed.import are not shown here.
